title: 2328. Number of Increasing Paths in a Grid

examples.explanation: The strictly increasing paths are: - Paths with length 1: [1], [1], [3], [4]. - Paths with length 2: [1 -> 3], [1 -> 4], [3 -> 4]. - Paths with length 3: [1 -> 3 -> 4]. The total number of paths is 4 + 3 + 1 = 8.
The strictly increasing paths are: - Paths with length 1: [1], [2]. - Paths with length 2: [1 -> 2]. The total number of paths is 2 + 1 = 3.
